capacity.semantics: Owned-array forecasts are not OS caps. RSS is a single measured process high-water including imports/JIT/warmups, sampled after public calls and before external validation; whole-team RSS was not measured by these process observations.

host_and_software.note: Python 3.12.13 / NumPy 2.5.3 / h5py 3.16.0 / Numba 0.67.0 on the same Windows 11, 20-logical-CPU host; package 0.4.0 versus 0.5.0.

limits: Full matrices qualify the recorded manufactured workloads and saved physical payloads, not all models or every Cartesian combination.
P14-U requests no trajectories; sample is IDs1..32 at0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5s (four probes,128 rows). Full-history1M output scaling is not inferred.
Process comparison is10k particles/320 macros,1/4 workers,none/sample; it is not a100k/1M process matrix.
Within-mode full science includes every emitted frame/probe; cross-mode equality compares core only because probes are intentionally added.

Separate raw SHA I/O covers context/final/committed-segment payload-roster bytes, not every artifact-directory file. Outcome reads, science hashing and verify_contents remain separate outside public_end_to_end.
Result4/5 opening and integrity policies differ; stage-time changes are product observations and cannot be labelled pure kernel speedup.
No unsaved-path equality, native COMSOL parity or experimental physical validation is inferred.
